scope: Independent public-reference simulation and test-planning portfolio; no OEM, employer or physical qualification claim.

statusDefinitions.demonstrated_in_simulation: Retained model, analysis or generated-data workflow; not measured hardware validation.
statusDefinitions.test_planned: Execution or review package prepared; not physically executed/approved.
statusDefinitions.physically_tested: Independent measured data with configuration identity and review; none in this study.
statusDefinitions.unresolved: Required real-world evidence unavailable; explicit closure path given.

evidence.title: Study requirements, operating limits and margins
evidence.description: Traceable selected mission, temperature, service and verification objectives.
evidence.boundary: Chosen study limits; supplier operating/survival allowables remain unknown.

evidence.title: Integrated day/night mission model and plots
evidence.description: Inspect connected subsystem temperatures, heat paths, electrical demand and battery SOC.
evidence.boundary: Representative 24-node architecture; not OEM telemetry or validated flight behavior.

evidence.title: Native OpenModelica source
evidence.description: Inspectable integrated thermal/control equations and parameter definitions.
evidence.boundary: Model fidelity and assumed data constrain physical accuracy.

evidence.title: Native CAD and component evidence
evidence.description: Public-reference assembly and source-tagged component envelopes.
evidence.boundary: 94 tagged CAD objects are not individually resolved thermal states; no production drawings.

evidence.title: Inherited materials, loads and thermal-path assumptions
evidence.description: Review optics, interfaces, insulation, power schedules and capacities before results.
evidence.boundary: Many physical properties, dimensions and loads are assumptions.

evidence.title: Night radiator, insulation and heater comparison
evidence.description: Compare fixed heat rejection, controlled paths, heater capacity and insulation.
evidence.boundary: Variable conductance is a hardware hypothesis; not a selected qualified thermal switch.

evidence.title: Representative 3D PCB temperature map and mesh
evidence.description: Inspect spatial component temperatures, interface options and numerical mesh evidence.
evidence.boundary: Independent representative board; no actual Sceye ECAD or semiconductor-junction validation.

evidence.title: Limited PI motor heater design
evidence.description: Compare proportional/PI control and energy.
evidence.boundary: Generic targets and loads; no selected motor allowable.

evidence.title: Cold-soak startup and response-delay comparison
evidence.description: Inspect true component temperatures, heater command/delivery and reserve over startup and settled windows.
evidence.boundary: Sensor and actuator dynamics are assumed; equipment cold operation is not physically proven.

evidence.title: Native conservation, delay and refinement checks
evidence.description: Read independent delay probes, energy checks and numerical sensitivity.
evidence.boundary: Code/numerical verification does not establish physical model validity.

evidence.title: Detailed telecom/server integration and design trade
evidence.description: Inspect 28-state expanded mission, service permissions and design comparisons; four additional states resolve telecom/server functions.
evidence.boundary: Representative architecture and study targets; physical correlation remains open.

evidence.title: Component-to-system spatial trade
evidence.description: Stage 06 finite-volume board solution and effective heat-path return to the mission; distinct from the earlier Stage 03 FEM board.
evidence.boundary: Selected steady spatial states and reduced paths do not establish universal dynamic equivalence.

evidence.title: Design decision record
evidence.description: Reasons for changed heat paths, reserved heater power, service controls and selected trade.
evidence.boundary: Candidate decisions for a representative study; not an approved flight design.

evidence.title: Mechanical, electrical, thermal and control interface record
evidence.description: Assembly features, harness leaks, surfaces, power accounting and review responsibilities.
evidence.boundary: Defined review plan; no cross-functional production sign-off or manufactured assembly.

evidence.title: Instrumented article and environmental test plan
evidence.description: Execution-ready sensor/power/environment ladder, held-out test logic and acceptance examples.
evidence.boundary: No physical article assembly or test execution.

evidence.title: Candidate sensor map
evidence.description: Named component, plate, gas, shroud, pressure and electrical measurement channels.
evidence.boundary: Locations and instruments must be finalized on actual hardware.

evidence.title: Environmental and calibration test matrix
evidence.description: Room, chamber, altitude, radiation, repeated assembly and held-out test definitions.
evidence.boundary: All tests are planned_not_executed.

evidence.title: Empty raw measurement CSV template
evidence.description: Header-only schema for synchronized raw measurements and event notes.
evidence.boundary: An empty template is not test data.

evidence.title: Illustrative measurement uncertainty budget
evidence.description: Separates sensor calibration, attachment, placement and DAQ contributions.
evidence.boundary: Allocated example uncertainties; no instrument certificates or measured repeatability.

evidence.title: Synthetic calibration and held-out prediction
evidence.description: Generated-data exercise: fit calibration run, freeze parameters, predict independent waveform and inspect residuals.
evidence.boundary: Synthetic observations are not measurements; physical correlation and model validity remain unresolved.

evidence.title: Synthetic workflow metrics and provenance
evidence.description: Retained generated-data, fit, held-out residual, energy and refinement metrics.
evidence.boundary: No physical data.

evidence.title: Sensor, heater and contact fault simulations
evidence.description: Inspect enabled service, temperature and reserve under degraded paths and controls.
evidence.boundary: Representative faults expose required mitigations; software or hardware safety not certified.

evidence.title: Risk register and qualitative FMEA
evidence.description: Failure causes, detection, effect, mitigation and closure evidence.
evidence.boundary: Analyst-proposed risks; likelihood and production acceptance have not been assessed.

evidence.title: Design review and readiness checklist
evidence.description: Review gates with explicit unapproved/physical-evidence-open dispositions.
evidence.boundary: Prepared checklist is not a completed signed review.

evidence.title: Standards applicability assessment
evidence.description: Official NASA, RTCA and NIST references, purpose and applicability limits.
evidence.boundary: No contractual category, test severity, certification or qualification claimed.

evidence.title: Six-step presenter guide
evidence.description: A 10–15 minute evidence-led walkthrough with direct links.
evidence.boundary: Shows analysis and planning; preserves explicit physical evidence gaps.

evidence.title: Completion boundaries and remaining physical closure
evidence.description: What is delivered, what is not measured, and what would close real-world readiness.
evidence.boundary: Actual laboratory execution, hardware qualification and OEM information remain unavailable.

evidence.title: Native Stage 06 telecom/edge assembly CAD
evidence.description: 240×180 mm representative board/plate assembly in native FreeCAD.
evidence.boundary: Independent design; no OEM internals or manufactured article.

steps.title: Mission and requirements
steps.remaining: Actual equipment BOM, supplier limits and mission telemetry unavailable.

steps.title: Integrated mission model
steps.remaining: Model is representative; measured input/flight validation not available.

steps.title: Component detail and design trade
steps.remaining: Real component package/junction maps and assembly measurements not available.

steps.title: Test-ready assembly and environment plan
steps.remaining: Article not assembled; facility, instruments and physical runs not executed.

steps.title: Correlation workflow and held-out prediction
steps.remaining: Synthetic workflow only; independent measured-data correlation unresolved.

steps.title: Fault response, risks and readiness
steps.remaining: No signed hardware readiness, qualification or flight operational approval.
